argv:
Rewrite the text following the principles of Simplified Technical English.

Use one topic per sentence. Keep procedural sentences to twenty words or
fewer and descriptive sentences to twenty-five words or fewer. Keep paragraphs
to six sentences or fewer.

Use the active voice. Address the reader directly with the imperative for
instructions. Use only the simple present, simple past, and simple future
tense.

Use one word for one meaning throughout, and one meaning for one word: never
vary a term for elegance. Prefer short, common words over long or technical
ones. Do not use noun clusters of more than three words. Write out what a
pronoun refers to whenever there is any doubt.

Do not use slang, idioms, or metaphors.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
This section applies even if other parts of this Agreement say something different.

The Subscriber may choose to turn on the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On. Schedule C defines this add-on. The Service may change Schedule C at any time.

If the Subscriber turns on the add-on, the Service will collect Usage Data. The Service may combine, anonymize, or process this Usage Data in other ways. The Subscriber licenses this Usage Data back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. This license applies whether or not the Service processes the data. The Subscriber can object to this license in writing. The Subscriber must send the objection within the period stated in Schedule D.

The Service may change this clause at any time. If the Subscriber keeps using the Service after a change, the Subscriber accepts the change. The Service may post notice of a change only on the Subscriber's account dashboard. The Service does not have to send notice directly to the Subscriber.
